items.title: mina meetings
items.snippet:
For the last 13 years Mina Shah has been helping audiences navigate the unknown to create a clear path forward and come out on top. The ability to change is impacted by the fear and uncertainty one experiences when embarking on something new and worthwhile. The ability to tap into ones courage and confidence during those crucial moments makes all the difference.
[...]
2014 Mina started mina meetings, a year long program teaching women confidence, communication skills and how to negotiate for themselves. She has produced and led over 235 events for women and consulted over 180 business owners.
[...]
Prior to starting her own organization she worked as the only female speaker at the time for Tony Robbins where she won the Presidents Award and Platinum Award selected by her peers for her performance and representing the mission

items.title: What If AI Fact-Checked Your Meetings in Real Time? Inside Meeting-Time AI Skills - DEV Community
items.snippet:
Current AI meeting tools handle the aftermath beautifully: transcription, summaries, action items. But they can't do anything about uncertain information spoken during the meeting. Mininglamp Technology built Octic around a specific question: what if AI could intervene during the meeting, not just after it?
[...]
This is why Mininglamp chose meeting-time assistance as the product focus rather than competing in the crowded post-meeting space. The two aren't on the same axis — one is about memory, the other is about judgment.
[...]
1. Fact Verification — Cross-references claims (numbers, dates, attributions) against the user's own documents and meeting history. Not a web search — a check against information the user has already seen.
[...]
Octic's approach is continuous context accumulation from the user's own data: meeting recordings, documents, conversations in Octo (Mininglamp's AI collaboration platform). Over time, the AI learns:
[...]
Mininglamp's Octic, with its 3-persona × 7-skill design, offers one coherent answer to how this can work. Personas solve the "when to speak" problem. Skills solve the "what to say" problem. Private AI memory solves the "how to be relevant" problem. Together, they define what it means for AI to move from post-meeting recorder to meeting-time advisor.

items.title: mina shah | Peak Performance Strategist Speaker
items.snippet:
Keynote Speaker, Strategic Coach and Founder of the mina meetings Showing you How to Access your Courage and Confidence During Uncertainty to Create a Clear Path Forward!
[...]
Founder at mina meetings
[...]
Mina Shah, Inspirational Keynote Speaker, Strategic Coach and Founder of the mina meetings. She has spoken to over 1400 audiences and strategically consulted over 180 business owners In 2011, while working as the only female Peak Performance Strategist for Tony Robbins, Mina Shah won the Presidents Award for creating transformation and measurable growth in businesses across America. Proud to receive the award, Mina is most proud that the same year she won the Platinum Award; an award selected by her peers for representing the mission and being a team player. At the end of 2012 Mina left her dream job at Robbins to pursue her dream. She saw a real need for programs that would teach women tools to create emotional, physical and financially freedom for themselves. In 2014 she launched mina meetings, to Empower Women to Know Their Value & Claim Their Worth. Since then she has produced and led over 235 events for women and witnessed not only the transformation in the lives of the women who have attended but also in the lives of their daughters who have attended in the following years. She shares the story of the women and mina meetings in her TEDx talk, What Happens When Women Stop Believing the Lies. In 2019 she was featured in SUCCESS magazine’s Women’s Empowerment Issue for her work making a difference in women’s lives. Her personal achievements include taking a 7 month trip around the world, climbing the highest mountain in SE Asia as well as completing a 12 day trek in the Himalayas. She believes that no matter where you came from you have the power to create the life you truly desire and it’s best to give yourself permission before you are ready.
[...]

[...]

[...]
